fields.label: Material Item
fields.description: The ERPNext stock Item — cost comes from its valuation / price.

fields.label: Mapping
fields.description: Which décor slot produced this line (cross-check vs the map).

fields.label: Qty
fields.description: Imported from the PDFs — not editable. Add extra hardware via the 'Add material row' button.

fields.label: Rate
fields.description: Always the stock price-list rate (Estimation (Assumed)) — change it THERE; history stays in the price list.

fields.label: Cust. Supplied
fields.description: Client buys & ships this material to us — excluded from the client price.

fields.label: Décor / Edge Band
fields.description: Search or create the real laminate / edge band for THIS line's slot — the SKU's décor map is updated and the line re-points on save.

fields.label: Décor (external face)
fields.description: Ply carries two faces: this maps the SECOND (external) slot letter. Leave blank when both faces share one décor.

fields.label: Disc %
fields.description: Discount on the stock price for THIS line only (the price list keeps its rate).

fields.label: Discount
fields.description: qty x rate x disc% — what this line saves.

fields.label: Net Rate
fields.description: Stock rate after this line's discount — what line_cost uses.

fields.label: Tax % (policy)
fields.description: The rate policy says applies to this item (Item.mallet_gst_pct, else the house GST%).

fields.label: Tax % (applied)
fields.description: Override for this line only. Blank = follow policy. Stock prices are kept PRE-tax, so this is the rate added on top.
